cues.en: In the last lecture, we created our droplet.

cues.zh: 這樣就能讓網域連結到 DigitalOcean Droplet；要將 DigitalOcean 帳號連結到 Namecheap 的網域，可以參考這份指南。

cues.en: This is some documentation on how to do that on this link, so feel free to read this.
cues.zh: 這個連結有相關文件，歡迎閱讀。

cues.en: Otherwise we're going to be doing it step by step.
So don't worry then if you don't use Namecheap you can consult this documentation.
cues.zh: 所以不用擔心；如果不是用 Namecheap，也可以參考這份文件。

cues.en: It shows you how to point DigitalOcean nameservers from the common domain registrars.
cues.zh: 它說明如何從常見網域註冊商，設定指向 DigitalOcean nameserver。

cues.en: And we have all these registrars like Bluehost, domain name, GoDaddy and all this.
So feel free to read this documentation.
So click on whichever host you like.
Let's it GoDaddy.
Then it will point you to the documentation on how to do the connection.
cues.zh: 就會連到如何完成連結的說明文件。

cues.en: Then let's go back to our Digital Ocean dashboard.
So for the current domains we can see DigitalOcean has set some TTL values.
cues.zh: 目前網域裡，可以看到 DigitalOcean 設定了一些 TTL 值。

cues.en: As you can see we have TTL values in seconds right here.
cues.zh: 這裡的 TTL 單位是秒。

cues.en: So basically our DNS TTL which means time to live, is a setting that tells the DNS resolver how long to cache a query before requesting a new one.
cues.zh: DNS TTL 是 Time to Live，告訴 DNS resolver 要快取查詢多久，再重新請求。

cues.en: So for example, now that our domain name has a TTL value of 3600 seconds, which is 60 minutes, the
cues.zh: 例如目前網域的 TTL 是 3600 秒，也就是 60 分鐘，

cues.en: resolver will have to gather the details around our web app on Devpost every 60 minutes, meaning if
cues.zh: resolver 每 60 分鐘才會重新取得網域相關資訊；講者接著說，

cues.en: 100 users visit the site in that period, which is 60 minutes, they will all see the same thing until the resolvers update their TTL.
cues.zh: 這段 60 分鐘內有 100 位使用者造訪，都會看到相同內容，直到 resolver 更新 TTL。

cues.en: We shall edit the DNS records on DigitalOcean to have short TTL values of about ten minutes.
cues.zh: 我們要把 DigitalOcean 的 DNS 紀錄 TTL 改短，約 10 分鐘。

cues.en: And so what you can do is just come and click on more, then edit record.
Then let's just change that to 600.
Do the same for this nameserver record, then this one, then this one too.
cues.zh: 其他 nameserver 紀錄也一樣，這個、這個，還有這個。

cues.en: Like that.
Then let's go to our domain name on Namecheap.
So let's go back to Namecheap dashboard.

Then after clicking on Domain list select the domain name.
Then click on manage.
Then after that we're going to scroll down to nameservers right here.
Then you're going to be presented with a page such as this.
So what you're going to do is we're going to go to nameservers which is somewhere right here.
Then we're going to select on custom DNS.
Then what you're going to do is we're going to add the DigitalOcean nameservers.
So let's go back to our DigitalOcean ocean dashboard.
Then these are the nameservers right here.
This NS values.
So click on copy.
Then go back to your domain registrar.
Mine being Namecheap.
Then paste it in.
Then do the same for the second one.
Go back, paste it in, then click on add Nameserver so that we can add the third one.
cues.zh: 回來貼上，再點 Add Nameserver，以新增第三個。

cues.en: So go back to your dashboard, click on copy paste it in.
cues.zh: 回到儀表板，複製後貼上。

cues.en: Then we can click on this checkbox right there to save.
Good.
You will see a pop up on Nameserver stating that the DNS propagation will take up to 48 hours, so you have to be patient.
cues.zh: Nameservers 會跳出提示，DNS 傳播可能需要最多 48 小時，所以要耐心等待。

cues.en: Then what you can do is back on DigitalOcean dashboard.
You're going to see that there is an A record already present.
cues.zh: 會看到已經有一筆 A 紀錄。

cues.en: This has been set with the hostname being the domain name we had set previously, and basically an A record, which is an address record in DNS is like a phonebook entry that connects a domain name, in
cues.zh: 主機名稱是先前設定的網域；A 紀錄就是 DNS 的位址紀錄，像電話簿，把網域名稱，

cues.en: our case to an IP address, which in our case is this particular IP address.
cues.zh: 對應到 IP 位址，也就是這個位址。

cues.en: Yours is going to be different.
So basically when we visit dev, our browser knows to connect to this particular IP address to get our API content.
cues.zh: 所以造訪網域時，瀏覽器知道要連到這個 IP，取得 API 內容。

cues.en: So we're also going to add three other records to redirect to the different subdomains that we're going to be using.
cues.zh: 接著還要加入其他紀錄，導向會用到的子網域。

cues.en: One is going to be the subdomain for API.
Then flour then traffic and then MLflow.
So let's scroll up.
They're all going to be a records.
cues.zh: 全部都使用 A 紀錄。

cues.en: You're going to make sure that you select a.
Then the host name is going to be API.
So as you can see right down here we're going to have a subdomain of api.dev.org.
cues.zh: 下面可以看到會形成 api 這個子網域，接上剛才的主網域。

cues.en: Then the resource is our droplet.
Make sure you select it.
Then the TTL can be 600.
Click on Create record.
Okay I made a mistake.

Create record, then the next one being traffic.

Then lastly we have MLflow.

And as you had seen on our domain registrar mine being Namecheap, we are told that DNS propagation takes up to 48 hours.
cues.zh: 剛才在 Namecheap 等網域註冊商看到，DNS 傳播最多需要 48 小時。

cues.zh: 有時比較快，有時比較慢。

cues.zh: 可以到 dnschecker.org，檢查 DNS 傳播狀態。

At times it takes shorter.
